details: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance has resumed user withdrawals after over $6 billion in virtual assets were stolen in what is believed to be the largest crypto heist in history. The US Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) has attributed the attack, which occurred around October 29, 2026, to North Korean hackers. Binance announced it would cover the losses, replenishing 90% of the stolen funds using company assets. The incident caused a sharp decline in major cryptocurrency prices, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Binance's native BNB token, due to heightened security concerns.
title: Binance Resumes Withdrawals After Record $6.3 Billion Crypto Heist Blamed on North Korea

details: Despite an easing of turmoil related to the Iran conflict and a rebound in oil supply, Brent crude prices remain over 60 percent higher than pre-war levels. This development suggests a partial stabilization in a key geopolitical hot spot, potentially reducing immediate supply chain disruptions and inflationary pressures in global energy markets. However, the sustained high prices indicate ongoing market sensitivity and underlying concerns.
title: Oil Flows Up as Iran War Turmoil Eases, But Prices Remain Elevated

details: Ripple has received final approval from the US Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) to establish a national trust bank. This regulatory milestone allows the newly chartered Ripple National Trust Bank to operate under federal supervision, manage reserves for Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin, and act as a collateral trustee for tokenholders. This is a significant step for Ripple in gaining mainstream financial integration and regulatory clarity.
title: Ripple Secures US Federal Banking Charter

details: Circle's USDC stablecoin has overtaken Tether's USDt in euro-denominated stablecoin trading. This shift is attributed to the influence of the European Union's Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA), which has reshaped competition between major stablecoins. Following the implementation of MiCA, several major cryptocurrency exchanges restricted USDt trading for customers in the European Economic Area, leading to increased liquidity and trading depth for USDC in euro markets.
title: USDC Surpasses Tether in Euro Trading Amidst EU MiCA Regulations
